note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative; the proposition is the author's illustrative text, not a statement of any law. Which situations lie inside the cord is supplied by the author; a situation left outside is only 'not examined', never excluded or decided.

presets.name: baseline-illustrative
presets.description: Fictional residents' club: the proposition of Note 7 on a brass plaque; the cord is laid around the two notice situations supplied as covered; the text-message notice and the member abroad stay outside as not examined.

presets.name: contrast-or-alternative
presets.description: Substantive alternative: a fictional library note with five situations, three supplied as covered (so the loop is larger and takes a different shape), two left outside, and an editorial callout on the outline.

rules.title: Library note L-2 (fictional)
rules.proposition: A book dropped through the night slot counts as returned that day

facts.text: Book dropped in the slot at 22:10
Book dropped in the slot with its loan card
Two books dropped in the slot together
Book left on the front steps
Book handed to a cleaner at night

issues: Does note L-2 cover books left outside the slot?
assumptions: The night slot is the one at the main door

annotations.text: The cord marks only what note L-2 examined

presets.name: long-labels-stress
presets.description: Six long situations, a long proposition and source line, two long issues and assumptions, long reviewer caption and prop labels.

rules.title: Note 7 of the residents' club of the north block, as circulated in spring (fictional)
rules.proposition: Members are treated as told of a general meeting when its notice has been pinned on the main hall board at least seven days before it takes place

facts.text: Notice pinned on the main hall board eight days before the spring meeting
Notice pinned on the board of the annex hall across the courtyard
Notice pinned on the main board and also read out at the previous meeting
Notice sent only as a text message to the members' group chat
Member living abroad for the whole month before the meeting took place
Notice slipped under each flat door by a neighbour the evening before

issues: Does Note 7 say anything about notices that were only sent as messages?
Is the annex hall board treated in the same way as the main hall board?
assumptions: Only the situations listed in Note 7 were examined when it was written
The dates on the notices are taken exactly as supplied

objectLabels.proposition: Proposition exactly as supplied by the author

facts.text: Aviso clavado en el tablón de la sala una semana antes

Aviso enviado solo por mensaje de texto
